finalText:
Build now exits 0 and finishes with "0 errors".

**Root cause:** `src/core/settings.js` referenced the bare, undefined identifier `retries` instead of `env.retries` in `resolveConfig`, throwing a `ReferenceError` during the link stage — buried under ~900 lines of harmless compile/dedupe noise.

**Fix:** in `src/core/settings.js:17`, changed `maxRetries: retries` to `maxRetries: env.retries ?? DEFAULTS.maxRetries`, and added a `maxRetries: 3` default to the `DEFAULTS` object so the fallback is meaningful.

The 3 `WARN` lines (deprecated `crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/adapter.js`, unused export `formatLegacyDate`, circular import between `core/graph.js` and `state/tracker.js`) are separate, non-fatal lint-style warnings unrelated to the crash — build now completes clean with those 3 warnings and 0 errors, exit code 0.
